summary: App needs a consistent global "Period Total" calculation formula across all reports and views; voucher tips must be supported as an optional field (defaulting to 0 when absent).
architectural_notes: Centralize totals computation in a single shared function/service to ensure the Period Total formula is identical across all reports/views.
Treat voucher tips as nullable/optional input; calculation should use 0 when missing.
known_issues: Reported totals calculation is incorrect relative to the required formula.
Imported data appears to include voucher tips unexpectedly (should generally be absent); investigate import vs report calculation.

existing_features.title: Update all places where the app reports a "Period Total" (and any other primary total meant to represent the driver’s owed/period amount) to ALWAYS use this canonical formula: ((credit meter + voucher meter − cash meter) ÷ 2) + credit tips + voucher tips.

Make voucher tips supported but optional: the app must allow voucher tips, but must not require voucher tips to be present in imported data or user entry; when absent they must default to 0 and not cause validation/import failures.

Ensure the frontend consistently labels and displays the canonical formula-based value as the main reported total ("Period Total" / per-day total) and does not accidentally substitute meter+tips totals in those locations.

new_feature_requests.summary: Apply the Period Total formula globally in all places totals are reported: ((credit meter + voucher meter − cash meter) ÷ 2) + credit tips + voucher tips
Support voucher tips as an optional value (rarely present); when not provided/imported, default voucher tips to 0 and do not require it

Fix backend daily report aggregation so that the report fields used by the frontend for per-day totals and summary Period Total are derived from the canonical formula (not from summing per-pickup meterTotal+tip). Ensure the report still returns meter and tip breakdowns by payment method (cash/credit/voucher) as it does today.

projectName: Apply canonical Period Total formula everywhere totals are reported; make voucher tips optional
